title: Workvivo HQ: Repositioning for the AI era
excerpt: Workvivo HQ repositioned the employee experience platform for an AI-native era without discarding its strengths in adoption, culture, frontline reach, and trust. The central idea—Give work a home—framed one destination where employees can communicate, find trusted answers, take action, and understand what is happening.

title: Workvivo HQ: Strategic contribution
excerpt: Shauna's contribution covered strategic positioning, category narrative, messaging for IT, HR, and Communications buyers, launch strategy, seller narrative, website story, analyst framing, and the portfolio narrative connecting Workvivo HQ to the broader AI strategy.

title: Workvivo HQ: Company proof points
excerpt: Workvivo publicly launched HQ while serving 9 million users and after surpassing $100 million in annual recurring revenue. These are company proof points from Shauna's tenure, not results attributed to her alone.

title: AI-enabled Product Marketing operating model
excerpt: Shauna is exploring how AI can change Product Marketing's operating model—not simply how a team uses ChatGPT. The work separates tasks suited to retrieval, monitoring, classification, and repeatable analysis from positioning, pricing, claims, category strategy, and executive recommendations that still require accountable human judgment.

title: Applied AI Product Marketing experiments
excerpt: The applied work includes seller-facing competitive intelligence, automated monitoring, AI-assisted win/loss analysis, AI Positioning QA, a grounded portfolio agent, and reusable research and synthesis workflows. Prototypes are used to learn before deciding whether to build, buy, or stop.

title: AI accelerates processing; people own decisions
excerpt: The operating principle is clear: AI can accelerate retrieval, processing, and repeatable analysis, while people remain accountable for positioning, pricing, claims, and consequential decisions. The proof is in workflow design and operating choices, not in collecting tools.

title: Shauna, Decoded: Portfolio agent architecture
excerpt: Shauna designed a live ElevenLabs voice and text portfolio agent around intent routing, modular RAG, persistent claim controls, focused specialist answer modes, and links back to public evidence. Versioned Markdown sources are converted into upload-ready HTML with a deterministic Node build script.

title: Shauna, Decoded: Evaluation and claim controls
excerpt: The agent uses a 13-question evaluation set with explicit pass criteria to test positioning, technical evidence, ownership boundaries, unsupported claims, role-fit nuance, leadership, and concise voice responses. A canonical claim ledger separates verified facts, public artifacts, self-reported experience, company context, and in-progress work.

title: HQ Agent: From search to answer to action
excerpt: HQ Agent extended Workvivo into trusted enterprise answers, search, self-service, and agentic task execution. Shauna shaped the commercial progression SEARCH → ANSWER → ACTION: from finding information, to receiving a grounded answer, to increasingly completing the task.

title: HQ Agent: Translating trust architecture
excerpt: The trust story translated retrieval, permissions, citations, and grounding into buyer value. Instead of unsafe absolute claims, the narrative used precise language such as grounded, cited, and permission-aware—and marketed the buyer value of RAG rather than the acronym itself.

title: HQ Agent: Commercialising enterprise AI
excerpt: Shauna's contribution included product and portfolio positioning, the AI maturity story, competitive framing, seller enablement, and pricing and packaging co-developed with the Revenue leader. The packaging decision was to price levels of AI value rather than charge for novelty.

title: Market leadership as a connected system
excerpt: Shauna approached analyst relations as a connected category system rather than a calendar of submissions. The analyst narrative, evidence base, competitive position, customer proof, and go-to-market story needed to reinforce one another across products evolving at different speeds.

title: Analyst narrative and evidence development
excerpt: The work spanned analyst narrative and executive storytelling, briefings and RFI development, evidence and customer-proof development, competitive positioning, claims governance, portfolio alignment, and campaigns that translated recognition into market-facing proof.

title: Recognition across analyst and review platforms
excerpt: Workvivo received recognition across Gartner, Forrester, G2, ClearBox, Gartner Peer Insights, and SoftwareReviews. Shauna played a substantial role in the program, while independent analysts and reviewers controlled their own evaluations and outcomes.

title: Meta migration: Turning disruption into opportunity
excerpt: When Meta announced the closure of Workplace, Workvivo was named its only preferred migration partner. The go-to-market challenge was to move quickly, differentiate against competitors, reduce migration risk, reassure customers, and turn a time-bound market event into durable commercial opportunity.

title: Meta migration: GTM contribution
excerpt: Shauna played a significant go-to-market role across migration positioning, competitive differentiation, seller strategy and enablement, market messaging, cross-functional coordination, and the customer story. The narrative balanced urgency with confidence in both the migration path and the destination.

title: Forrester recognised Workvivo's cross-functional response
excerpt: Forrester named Workvivo its 2026 B2B Return on Integration Honors winner for a cross-functional response to a major market disruption. Shauna's portfolio identifies the recognised programme as the Meta migration and records her as a significant GTM contributor; the award is a company outcome.

title: Seer: The Listening Gap
excerpt: Seer's story centred on the Listening Gap: organisations often collect employee feedback but struggle to turn what they hear into meaningful action. The narrative moved beyond survey collection through LISTEN → UNDERSTAND → ACT, connecting qualitative signal to insight for leaders and managers.

title: The Listening Funnel framework
excerpt: The Listening Funnel organised the research around three stages: inclusion in feedback programmes, leadership accountability for what is heard, and visible impact so employees can see change. The action layer recommended designing for every employee, taking visible action, holding leaders accountable, closing the loop, and breaking down feedback silos.

title: Seer: Entering people intelligence
excerpt: Shauna's contribution covered positioning, go-to-market and launch strategy, pricing and packaging, competitive strategy, and seller enablement. The story used AI-assisted topic grouping, comment analysis, and sentiment as means to insight, while keeping practical manager action at the centre. No unverified Seer revenue or adoption metrics are claimed.

title: Positioning and narrative
excerpt: Shauna turns complex products and crowded markets into a focused, ownable reason to choose. Her work connects technical architecture to buyer value, positioning, category strategy, launch narratives, and go-to-market systems that sellers and cross-functional teams can use.

title: AI-native go-to-market
excerpt: Shauna uses AI as both product context and operating leverage across research, creation, monitoring, and iteration. Her approach starts with workflows rather than tool collecting and keeps accountable human review around positioning, pricing, claims, and strategic recommendations.

title: Enterprise AI and context systems
excerpt: Shauna works across enterprise retrieval and RAG, AI search, grounding and citations, permissions, orchestration, agentic workflows, MCP, and enterprise integrations. Her focus is understanding enough of the system to make better product, pricing, trust, and go-to-market decisions.

title: Product Marketing leadership
excerpt: Shauna's leadership approach treats Product Marketing as a company capability: define a clear remit, build strong cross-functional interfaces, and create repeatable decision systems and operating rhythms that make the function effective.

title: Hands-on AI systems
excerpt: Shauna built and deployed this JSON-driven GitHub Pages portfolio with a grounded conversational agent, and built the public AI Positioning QA project to turn Product Marketing criteria into a repeatable AI-assisted review workflow. She also prototypes research, competitive, win/loss, and recurring PMM workflows.

title: Top 1% of Replit Agent users
excerpt: Replit ranks Shauna in the top 1% of Replit Agent users and summarises her demonstrated capability as taking applications from an initial prompt through build and iteration to a deployed production release. This is a Replit-generated assessment based on app usage, not an independent software-engineering certification.
